_comment: Full-control guide for NoteKar remote notifications hosted at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dheeraz101/NotekarN/refs/heads/main/notification.json. Keep notification.json a valid JSON array of notice objects. Change id whenever you want users to see a new notice.
_quick_rules: Keep notification.json valid JSON: no comments and no trailing commas.
The root of notification.json must be a JSON array containing notice objects.
Change the 'id' for every new campaign. Devices remember ids to avoid repeated spam.
Use enabled:false to pause or disable a specific campaign without deleting it from the file.
High priority ('priority':'high') notices bypass the 24-hour cooldown timer and show immediately (ideal for urgent fixes/migration messages).
Users can tap the native 'Dismiss' action button on Android to permanently ignore a campaign (stores shownCount = 9999 in SharedPrefs).
Include localized overrides (like title_hi, body_es) to show notices in the user's preferred language.

_fields.enabled: Boolean. true allows this notice to be checked. false disables it immediately.
_fields.id: Required unique string. Change this for a new notification campaign. Example: release-4-0-5 or security-fix-001.
_fields.title: Required default notification title (English).
_fields.body: Required default notification message (English). Keep it under 120 characters.
_fields.url: Tap target. Full https URLs open in browser. './?action=settings' style URLs open specific in-app destinations.
_fields.action: Optional Android-first app destination. Supported: history, settings, whats-new, changelog, note, moment, releases.
_fields.priority: Optional priority string: 'low', 'normal', 'high'. Highest priority active notice is selected first. 'high' priority bypasses local cooldown checks.
_fields.minVersion: Optional. Lowest app version (e.g. 4.0.0) that should receive this notice.
_fields.maxVersion: Optional. Highest app version (e.g. 4.0.4) that should receive this notice.
_fields.maxShows: Number. Maximum times one device may show this id. Recommended: 1.
_fields.cooldownHours: Number. Minimum hours between repeat displays for this id (bypassed if priority is high).

_supported_android_actions.moment: Logs a moment, respecting tap delay.
